gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.365243 42.254203)',4326)::geography, 500)
  AND p.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND elev.z >= 180;

WITH biggby_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-84.365243, 42.254203), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geom, 500) AS geom
  FROM biggby_point
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip((SELECT rast FROM dem_clip), (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area), TRUE))).sum / (ST_Area((SELECT geom FROM buffered_area)::geometry, FALSE) / (ST_UpperLeftX((SELECT rast FROM dem_clip)) - ST_UpperLeftX(ST_Transform(ST_Envelope((SELECT geom FROM buffered_area)), 4326))))^2) AS avg_elevation
)
SELECT 
  'Biggby, Jackson, MI' AS reference_point,
  (SELECT geom FROM biggby_point) AS reference_geometry,
  (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area) AS buffer_geometry,
  avg_elevation
FROM 
  elevation_values
WHERE 
  avg_elevation >= 180;
